instruction: Open-choice CLI requirement: This environment provides three candidate engineering toolchains, including BIM-capable tools and a distractor tool. Choose an appropriate BIM-capable command-line or official automation workflow from these options to edit C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc and export the completed IFC4 deliverable as C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc. Do not directly create, rewrite, patch, copy, or post-process IFC outside the selected BIM toolchain. The current model is a narrow three-storey shell. The owner wants a simple vertical program stack: reception at street level, studio above, and archive on the top floor, without changing the outer mass.
source: Open-choice BIM environment; evaluation checks IFC deliverable semantics rather than the selected tool.
